{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid sonic sensors Type 3''' were devices that aided a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the detection of intruders hidden or visually camouflaged by means other than [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth fields]]. These sensors were of the best quality available and therefore provided excellent background noise filtering that greatly improved detection performance.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
